# The Nice Beach Properties

> Four private beachfront vacation homes in Río Grande and Luquillo, Puerto Rico, managed by Superhosts (Nice Rental Management Corporation). Each home has a private pool, direct beach access and room for groups of 10 to 16 guests. 15 minutes from El Yunque National Rainforest and about 40 minutes from San Juan airport (SJU). Book direct at https://thenicebeachproperties.com/ for the best rate.

## Homes

- [The Nice Beach Oasis](https://thenicebeachproperties.com/#oasis): Río Grande. Up to 16 guests, 6 bedrooms, 8 beds, 5.5 baths. Private pool and jacuzzi, ocean-view balcony, covered BBQ for 8, paddle boards. Rated 5.0. Best for large families, reunions and group trips.
- [The Nice Beach Villa](https://thenicebeachproperties.com/#villa): Playa Fortuna, Luquillo. Up to 14 guests, 5 bedrooms, 7 beds, 6.5 baths. Private pool and hot tub, private beach access, kayak. Rated 4.96.
- [The Nice Beach House](https://thenicebeachproperties.com/#house): Las Picúas, Río Grande. Up to 12 guests, 5 bedrooms, 9 beds, 4 baths. Private pool, steps from the sand, fully fenced yard. Rated 4.93.
- [The Nice Beach Bungalow](https://thenicebeachproperties.com/#bungalow): Playa Fortuna, Luquillo. Up to 10 guests, 3 bedrooms, 5 beds, 3 baths. Tropical garden, pool, hammock. Rated 5.0.

## Good to know

- Check-in after 4:00 PM, checkout before 11:00 AM, self check-in with smart lock.
- Free parking, Wi-Fi, washer and dryer, full kitchen, BBQ grill and beach gear in every home.
- No pets, no parties or events. Pools are not fenced; children must be supervised.
- Cancellation: full refund 14+ days before check-in, 50% between 14 and 7 days, no refund within 7 days.
- Nearby: Playa Las Picúas, Luquillo Beach and kioskos, El Yunque (La Coca and La Mina falls), Carabalí Rainforest Park, Wyndham Grand Rio Mar golf, catamaran trips to Icacos and Culebra.
- Also listed on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com.

## En español

Cuatro casas privadas frente al mar en Río Grande y Luquillo, Puerto Rico, para grupos de 10 a 16 personas, con piscina privada y acceso directo a la playa, a 15 minutos de El Yunque. Reserva directo en https://thenicebeachproperties.com/
